page.overview:
What is Uta Uta no Mi?

The Uta Uta no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to teleport people's consciousnesses into a virtual space, which they have complete control over, by singing. It was eaten by Uta.

The Uta Uta no Mi is a round, pink fruit with a green stem shaped like a musical note or specifically the accented eighth note. There are four colored rings around the middle of the fruit, in the following order from top to bottom: yellow, orange, red, blue; which form lines reminiscent of those of the . Like all Devil Fruits, its surface is covered in spirals.

The most essential aspect of this fruit's power is the user possessing the ability to send the consciousness of anyone who hears them sing into a dream dimension known as Uta World. This power will affect not only people who hear the user in person, but also those hearing the user's voice broadcasted to them at least by Transmission Den Den Mushi. It appears that the user can still sing without invoking this power, as Uta did not send anyone who heard "Tot Musica" or "The World's Continuation" into Uta World. Uta World is completely identical to the real world, meaning those who are not aware of the power will likely not know they were transported. It is not possible for those placed in Uta World to get back to the real world on their own. The user of the fruit will maintain two versions of themselves which are capable of simultaneously acting in both worlds seemingly without issue.

In Uta World, the user of this fruit is near-omnipotent and can do almost anything they imagine, including flying, conjuring an unlimited assortment of objects from thin air, and telekinetically changing the landscape. The user is capable of transforming those they trap into inanimate objects, and can even conversely transform objects like the Thousand Sunny into living beings. They can heal wounds and even possibly resurrect anyone who dies, as Uta showed with two of Charlos' bodyguards. However, physical alterations performed in Uta World do not carry over to the real world.
